q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: WITH TEMP AS ( SELECT S.NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN C.NAME = 'RED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HAS_RED FROM SALESPERSON S LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON S.SALES_ID = O.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID GROUP BY S.NAME ) SELECT NAME FROM TEMP WHERE HAS_RED = 0
